message_text: Can you help me figure out which electives to take for the Business Administration major?
Of course! Popular electives include Digital Marketing (BUS 340), Entrepreneurship (BUS 360), Data Analytics for Business (BUS 375), and Negotiation Strategies (BUS 310).
Which ones are good for someone interested in starting their own business?
I'd recommend Entrepreneurship (BUS 360) and Small Business Finance (BUS 355). Both include real-world project components where you develop a business plan.
Those sound perfect! Are they offered next semester?
BUS 360 is offered every semester, and BUS 355 is offered in Spring. Both still have open seats.
Happy to help! Good luck with your studies.
